known_limits.evidence: 342/530 deaths have a lives decrement; 188/530 occur while lives==0 (EXP-P2-004 §1)
known_limits.implication: any HUD-only death detector caps at 64.53%; last-life deaths need a pixel/visual anchor

known_limits.evidence: 188/530 deaths in the v4.0 corpus; WP5 round1 has 139/1325 deaths with bombs==0 and a +29-frame HUD path
known_limits.implication: the old +4/+10 latency window is a corpus artifact; the visible dissolve is still 0..4 frames, but HUD confirmation is late

known_limits.evidence: NCC 1.0->0.38 in the death window, but non-death frames have 1% low NCC; NCC 16.41%/17.43%; CNN 8.38%/2.08% offline
known_limits.implication: a hand threshold or a small global CNN is not enough; need localization + local window + state fusion

known_limits.evidence: T2a PlayerLocator median error 11.59 px vs 4 px gate; obs-v3 deliberately excludes self_state (obs_spec_v3.py:35-40,133-141)
known_limits.implication: NCC's engine px/py dependency cannot be replaced without a better pixel locator; this is a hard prerequisite

known_limits.evidence: pixel onset median -112 frames vs engine bit; old gate 15/55; slice 248/250 is an artifact of cropping the lead (EXP-P2-011 §3.1)
known_limits.implication: the old window must not be reused; G410-3 needs the visible anchor frozen before detector work

known_limits.evidence: 89-frame latency; WP5 round1 0/415 because episodes closed before the 60-frame lag; round2 253/260 at +88/89
known_limits.implication: the static rule is a confirmation feature, not a first-visible detector; a panel/edge detector is needed

known_limits.evidence: HUD draws displayScore rolling with (score-displayScore)>>5; settled sign 99.56%, rolling 47.73%, integer 21.8%; score has no decrement path except stage reset
known_limits.implication: reward must use visible displayScore with settled logic; score negatives only at stage reset and must not be counted as damage

known_limits.evidence: v1 event head did not converge (0.37% recall); v0 learned dive-specific cues; threshold transfer across stages failed
known_limits.implication: do not start with a learned event head; start with interpretable HUD/state rules and add learning only for failure slices

known_limits.evidence: v0 split by stage; stage-clear by replay; D1 has seeds but no ancestor graph
known_limits.implication: v4.1 must split by original trajectory/ancestor and seal confirmation; otherwise repeated windows inflate n

known_limits.evidence: 469,216 D1 label rows: death=0, bomb=0, hit=95, dying=24, stage_clear 0x80=270; 45 shards stopped on death
known_limits.implication: D1 frame_event_flags is a per-decision single-frame snapshot; it cannot be event truth and must not be used to fit/evaluate events

known_limits.evidence: detector requires index schema v400-p2det-index-1 and label_version p2-v2-1; D1 is v400-teacher-obs-1 and has no li/bo/sc columns
known_limits.implication: no adapter exists; the existing train-v1 path cannot consume D1 or the v4.1 DAgger labels

known_limits.evidence: stored HUD is 56x160 green-channel; v4.1 requires the original client area or a selected region preserving HUD
known_limits.implication: reuse geometry but collect full-resolution color HUD; a model trained on 56x160 cannot see color/icons/menus

known_limits.evidence: game_over truth is HUD gameOverFlag or harness STEP game_over; no engine event bit; pause/menu has no engine bit
known_limits.implication: menu truth needs input logs + visible annotation; game_over truth can only be used offline

known_limits.evidence: 0x0080 is exported only by rl_events and is a level bit (79 frames in the captured event); stage index flips 77 frames later
known_limits.implication: do not require the bit in runtime; do not treat it as an edge; keep engine labels separate from visible anchors

known_limits.evidence: proportion() uses z=1.96 and pass_99 compares the 95% LB to 0.99; at n=400 zero failures the 95% LB is 99.049% but the 99%-confidence LB is 98.665% (needs n>=536)
known_limits.implication: pre-register the confidence convention; recommend >=550 events/class so both readings pass

known_limits.evidence: D1 label rows carry stage=0/difficulty=0 even for a stage-7/difficulty-1 shard (observed on d1-s7d1-n3218-seed1-shard); row-level stage/difficulty are not authoritative
known_limits.implication: always use shard.json for stage/difficulty/seed; never group or split by the label row's stage field

events.name: death
events.anchor: A_death = first frame a human can see the death: sprite vanish/dissolve OR death effect at the player position; HUD lives decrement only if both visual cues are invisible; respawn-only as last resort
events.engine_truth: EVENTS & 0x4 rising edge; also EVENTS & 0x200 (dying started) as a diagnostic
events.primary_latency: alarm - A_death, P95 <= 10, matching window [A_death, A_death+10], before=0
events.secondary_latency: alarm - engine death frame, P95 <= 30, max <= 60, signed
events.denominator: all real deaths, including last-life, death-bomb failure, stage/menu-period deaths; unobservable listed separately but not removed
events.notes: one death emits once; respawn blink cannot fire a second death

events.name: bomb
events.anchor: first frame the bombs icon count decreases (same frame as engine 0x1); bomb activation effect only if HUD unreadable
events.denominator: all bomb uses; death-frame bomb-stock movement is ambiguous and must be attributed to death, not counted as a bomb event unless a bomb activation is visible
events.notes: G2C proves 436/436 same-frame with HUD decrement

events.name: death_bomb
events.anchor: bomb activation/consumption during HIT_PENDING with no lives decrement
events.engine_truth: no dedicated bit; use 0x2 + 0x1 + input log
events.denominator: subset of bomb events; must not be counted as death
events.notes: a late death-bomb that still dies is a death (and may also consume a bomb)

events.name: respawn
events.anchor: first frame the player sprite reappears at the bottom after a death
events.engine_truth: no engine bit; visible annotation; engine player_state/py only offline
events.denominator: death subset with lives>0; report separately
events.notes: invincibility blink is expected; stable K frames ends RESPAWN

events.name: stage_transition
events.anchor: A_stage_visible = first frame of the stage-clear sequence (boss death/white flash/panel/banner), independently annotated; NOT the engine bit or stage index
events.engine_truth: EVENTS & 0x80 rising edge (level bit) and STATE.stage change
events.secondary_latency: lead vs engine bit and stage index, signed, reported only
events.denominator: all stage transitions in Normal s0-s7; >=400 total, >=30 per stage
events.notes: old [edge, edge+10] window is not used; old G2 remains separate

events.name: game_over
events.anchor: first frame the terminal game-over/continue/retry panel or letterbox is visible; NOT after 60 static frames
events.notes: retry menu is part of GAME_OVER; it is a menu_kind=retry sub-event, not a separate menu denominator

events.name: menu
events.anchor: first frame a non-terminal pause/title/options menu is visible
events.engine_truth: input log + visible annotation; no engine bit
events.notes: game-over retry menu is excluded from this denominator to avoid double counting

events.name: hit_pending
events.anchor: first frame of blink/white flash/local novelty spike
events.notes: used to disambiguate death-bomb and avoid counting a hit as a death

death_anchor.definition: A_death is the earliest frame at which a human can see that the player died, independently annotated and frozen before detector evaluation; it is not the engine death bit and not the HUD lives decrement when the sprite dissolve is visible.
death_anchor.visual_timing: the sprite is gone/dissolving 0..4 frames after the engine death bit (EXP-P2-008 §14); the +29-frame path is a HUD refresh delay, not a later visual death
death_anchor.annotation: two independent annotators blind to detector output and engine frames; adjudication for disagreements; anchor_version + sha256 + adjudication record frozen

latency.secondary: alarm - engine death frame, P95 <= 30, max <= 60, signed

inclusion: all real deaths, including last-life, death-bomb failure, deaths during stage transition or menu, and deaths under partial occlusion
unobservable deaths (UNKNOWN/black/cutscene) are listed as an unobservable subset and stay in the denominator
do not delete an event because no detector could see it; do not add repeated replays as independent events
forbidden: using the HUD lives decrement as the primary anchor when the sprite dissolve is visible
using engine EVENTS/STATE/HUD truth at runtime
changing the anchor after seeing detector output

targets.lives: 0..6 or unknown; star icons; increase=extend or reset; decrease=death
targets.bombs: 0..8 or unknown; bomb icons; decrease=bomb or death handling; increase=pickup or reset

cause_attribution: lives decrease: death event only; must be paired with a death state
lives increase: extend vs stage reset/continue; cause=extend or cause=reset
bombs decrease: bomb event vs death handling; use bomb activation visual; if ambiguous, label ambiguous and do not count as a bomb

checks: same ancestor across splits -> fail closed

confirmation opened before freeze -> fail closed

confirmation_seal.manifest: confirmation-manifest.json with sha256, seed ranges, trajectories, event counts per class, engine SHA

data_plan.no_synthetic: confirmation must be real engine frames; synthetic overlays/augmentation may only be used in training and must be labeled; they cannot enter confirmation

event_pr.matching: one-to-one greedy; p matches d iff A_d <= p <= A_d+10; each prediction at most one event; unmatched predictions are FP

confidence.primary_readme: one-sided 95% Wilson LB >=0.99 (z=1.959963985); at n=400 zero failures LB=0.990488 (passes)
confidence.stricter: one-sided 99% Wilson LB (z=2.326347874); at n=400 zero failures LB=0.986651 (fails); n>=536 needed
confidence.rule: pre-register one convention in the manifest; report both; never switch after seeing results

clusters.method: per-cluster recall/precision + 10,000 cluster bootstrap; 99% percentile interval; report design effect
clusters.primary_if: design effect > 1.5 -> cluster interval is primary; Wilson is secondary

event_pr.zero_samples: never pass; never report 0% or 100%; predictions <400 fail closed

latency.method: nearest-rank ceil(0.95*n)-1; report median/max/n; n<20 also list every event
latency.confirmation_delay: sustain/confirmation frames are included in latency; never subtract them

resources.lives_bombs: per-segment (600 frames) accuracy; Wilson 95% LB >=0.995; worst trajectory/window reported; unknown <=1% per field
resources.score: per-digit/integer/settled sign; settled sign LB >=0.99; rolling diagnostic; negative class (stage reset) reported separately; no negative -> untestable
resources.reward: visible displayScore + resource/event reward; per-episode cumulative reward error; resource inconsistency count; reset causes excluded from damage reward
resources.no_frame_weighting: do not let 100k static frames dominate the confidence; segment/trajectory weighting is mandatory

report: Poisson/rule-of-three upper bound if zero FP
long_run.fail_closed: no 0-event segment -> cannot claim the long-run gate

restart.driver: pixel-terminal only (GAME_OVER/MENU); no engine terminal truth
restart.claim: 99/100 is a point estimate; report Wilson interval and do not claim a 99% lower bound

risks.residual: reset and death can co-occur; state machine priority resolves
